n: Industrial L3 Managed PoE Switch Planet
d: IP30 19" Rack Mountable Industrial L3 Managed PoE Switch, 24- Port 10/100/1000T 802.3at PoE + 4-Port 10G SFP+ (-40 to 75 C, dual redundant power input on 48~56VDC, DIDO, ERPS Ring, 1588, Modbus TCP, ONVIF, Cybersecurity features, Hardware Layer3 OSPFv2, fanless design, supports CloudViewer app and MQTT, supports 100FX, 1000X, 2.5G SFP and 10G SFP+)

specs.label: SFP/mini-GBIC Slots
specs.value: 4 100/1000BASE-X SFP interfaces, shared with Port-21 to Port-24 Backward compatible with 100BASE-FX SFP transceiver

specs.label: SFP+ Slots
specs.value: 4 10GbBASE-SR/LR SFP+ interfaces (Port-25 to Port-28) Backward compatible with 1000BASE-SX/LX/BX and 2500BASE-X SFP

specs.label: PoE Injector Port
specs.value: 24 ports with 802.3af/at PoE injector function with Port-1 to Port-24

specs.label: Address Table
specs.value: 16K entries, automatic source address learning and aging

specs.label: Flow Control
specs.value: IEEE 802.3x pause frame for full duplex Back pressure for half duplex
